notes.title: Boxed Game, Artbook and poster add ons shipping before Christmas!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/bdSZDm4.jpg[/img]

Dear Woolfe backers,

When Rebellion acquired Woolfe back in October we promised we’d honour as many of the digital and physical rewards as possible, and we kicked off the process of packing, labelling (and envelope-licking!) in November, shipping out the first wave of outstanding posters, stickers and certificates.  

But we have some more great news to finish the year off! Our in-house art team have been busy creating both a stunning, custom-designed Boxed version of the game, and also a Hardcover Artbook which were originally offered as optional “Add ons” to backers of the Kickstarter campaign.

Not only are these now designed and printed, but we have started shipping them to all the appropriate backers - [b]this means some of you may even get all your rewards in time for Christmas![/b]

And if that’s simply too far away, you can check out this video we made with our Head of Art, Chris, to get a sneak preview of what to expect!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=59tfdP40tg8&feature=youtu.be
As the backers who made Woolfe possible, we hope you enjoy finally getting your rewards as much as we have making them.  

We understand you’ve probably still got a few questions, so we’ve also got a published a quick FAQ below, but as ever feel free to get in touch at [b]woolfe.support@rebellion.co.uk[/b]

From everyone at Rebellion, we wish you a great Christmas and a cracking 2016!

[h1]I’m a backer and I bought add ons, so what do I get?[/h1]
[b][u]If you purchased the “Hardcover Artbook” add on...[/u][/b]
… you get a 60 page, 18cm x 26cm Hardcover Artbook designed and published by Rebellion featuring a Foreword from Grin’s Wim Wouters, as well as art from pre-production, characters, environments, graphic design and even fans themselves!

[b][u]If you purchased the “Boxed” version add on...[/u][/b]
… you get the Woolfe PC game on DVD and the soundtrack on CD, all presented in a custom, double-sided box and sleeve, gloss black printed on matt black, and finished with a triple spot UV thorn “embossed-style” design created by the artists at Rebellion. 

You’ll notice too that the box has a unique double-sided design both inside and out, featuring Red and BB. Woolfe.

We’ve only made a tiny batch of these Boxed editions, and we don’t have plans to sell them at retail, so they are very rare indeed!

[b][u]If you purchased a “Deluxe Boxed” Version physical add on...[/u][/b]
...you get: 
[list]
[*]The new special Boxed version which includes the game DVD and soundtrack CD (as detailed above)
[*]The Hardcover Artbook
[*]5 Woolfe posters, including one signed by members of the original dev team at Grin
[*]Sniper Elite Steam key
[*]Sniper Elite V2 Steam key
[*]Sniper Elite 3 Steam key
[/list]
[b][u]If you purchased the “Poster pack” physical add on...[/u][/b]

You will receive 4 posters as outlined in the original Kickstarter.

[h1]When will I get the items above?[/h1]

We’ve already begun shipping! If you live in the UK or Europe, there is a chance you’ll get your items before Christmas. Shipping times will vary depending on where you live, and what you originally ordered. Hopefully all of you will have your items by the first week in January!

[h1]What happened to the “Deluxe Boxed” version that was promised as a physical add on?[/h1]

Grin’s original Kickstarter campaign included the option to purchase a “Deluxe Boxed” add on for $120 that featured a complex 3D printed design.

While there was an illustration of the design on Woolfe’s Kickstarter page, no completed samples or designs were ever given to Rebellion when we purchased Woolfe in October 2015.

To replicate the design Grin proposed, we discovered that each individual Deluxe Boxed version would cost many hundreds of dollars to produce!

To make up the value of what you originally ordered, anyone who ordered the Deluxe Boxed version will get the beautiful new Boxed version (including game DVD and CD soundtrack), the Hardcover Artbook, 5 posters (including one signed by members of Grin), and also Steam keys for Rebellion’s Sniper Elite series (three games worth $90) which you can use yourself or gift to anyone you like.

We’re sorry we couldn’t deliver the exact specifications of Grin’s original add on plans, but we think you’ll still appreciate the care and design that we put into the (very rare!) Boxed Version that you receive, as well as the other gifts.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/f3iGGNl.jpg[/img]

notes.title: And so it begins - Rewards are starting to ship!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello everyone![/h1]
It’s been a couple of weeks since we at Rebellion announced our big Woolfe news and made the pledge to try and deliver all the physical Kickstarter rewards that you, the backers, are due. 

[b]Today we’re delighted to say we’ve begun the process of sending out rewards![/b]

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/004/835/528/e1b31b0c275f31a1f94833894f858070_original.jpg?v=1446645662&w=639&fit=max&auto=format&q=92&s=2cb00c33640376b86f742b142c1a038b[/img]
 
Now, when we say “the process,” we’re talking about something that isn’t going to take place over a few days. To give you a rough idea, we’ve started sending out Woolfe poster packs as well as letters containing official documents of enlistment and limited edition stickers. 

With the latter, there are actually more than 1,100 letters for us to send out – by hand! And we have a limited team organizing everything and making sure rewards go out to the right people. 

[img]https://ksr-ugc.imgix.net/assets/004/835/532/9ab027ea3cb6c845898cb2e70b683e8f_original.JPG?v=1446645687&w=639&fit=max&auto=format&q=92&s=15907e636aa73ac4438ce96d8bcba212[/img]

Then there’s the small matter of the rewards we’re making ourselves! The art book, for example, is something we’re physically creating in the studio, as is the deluxe boxed edition of Woolfe. 

The long and short of it is that this is going to take us some time! But we’re still confident in our aim to get everything into your hands by the end of the year. And hopefully you are one of the many this week to find the first batch of rewards on your doorstep, finally in your hands.

We’ll make sure to keep you updated on our progress both on Kickstarter and through the Woolfe [url=https://twitter.com/woolfegame] Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/woolfegame] Facebook[/url] pages, so please stay tuned. Also, we wanted to take this opportunity to say thank you for your support since our announcement. We appreciate this kind of transition is never an easy thing for anyone involved, so to read positive messages and such passion from Woolfe fans has been so encouraging and gratifying. 

Right, that’s all for now, except for a reminder that if you have any questions about the news, the rewards, or what all this means for Woolfe, please read last month’s [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/45588301/woolfe-the-red-hood-diaries/posts/1389243] update and FAQ[/url]. 

Thanks - and stay tuned!

notes.title: Welcome to the Rebellion family!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/Mrw6uhI.jpg[/img]

[h1]Dear Kickstarter backers and owners of Woolfe – The Red Hood Diaries[/h1]
In August, GRIN’s founder Wim Wouters wrote a brave and searingly honest statement about the sad closure of the studio and the end of Woolfe as they knew it. If you missed this, then we highly recommend you read [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/45588301/woolfe-the-red-hood-diaries/posts/1168409]Wim’s post[/url] before continuing. But in summary, GRIN was unable to continue as a business and had to apply for bankruptcy, and so Woolfe (and everything related to the game) was put up for sale at auction.

It has been a difficult time for those involved with Woolfe and for you, the backers, but today we’re writing to tell you that Woolfe is still alive, and now in the hands of a new owner, [url=http://www.rebellion.co.uk/]Rebellion[/url]– that’s us! We’re delighted to add Woolfe’s gorgeous, twisted universe to our burgeoning list of indie games and we hope you’ll join us for the ride.

You’re still probably wondering what this all means. Where does this leave backers? What’s the future of Woolfe? Who are Rebellion anyway? 

We’ve tried to answer all your questions below so please take time to read our responses if you can, and if you can’t find an answer to your question then feel free to get in touch with us at woolfe.support@rebellion.co.uk, or hit us up at [url=https://twitter.com/Rebellion]@Rebellion[/url] on Twitter! 

Thank you for reading this, and we hope to meet you in the forums and on social media in the very near future. 

- Jason and Chris Kingsley, Co-founders and owners of Rebellion. 

[h1]So who are Rebellion?[/h1]
For those who don’t know us, we’re an independent games studio with headquarters based in Oxford, in the UK.

We’ve been around for 23 years and we’re probably best known for the Sniper Elite series (which has just turned 10 years old!), Zombie Army Trilogy, Rogue Trooper and of course the seminal Aliens vs Predator games. 

[h1]Why did Rebellion buy Woolfe?[/h1] 
Aside from developing our own IP, Rebellion occasionally acquires unique and exciting projects from other developers, and we like to think we have one of the most diverse games portfolios out there. 

Interestingly, our book imprints have published quite a few dark and twisted retellings of classic tales, and so Woolfe’s gorgeous, twisted take on Red Riding Hood immediately caught our interest when we heard it was up for sale. 

But aside from our experience of self-publishing games on Steam for PC, we dug a little further and discovered many of Woolfe’s Kickstarter backers had still not received their rewards. 

With our connections to merchandise companies, book printers and the like, we realised we’d also be better placed than most companies to step in and provide backers with their rewards. 

[h1]Will Kickstarter backers receive outstanding rewards? If so, when?[/h1]
That’s the plan! When we purchased Woolfe we were also given access to some of the unsent merchandise and backer rewards, both digital and physical.

We’ve still got to do a full stock-take of exactly what rewards we have, and which rewards we’ll have to produce ourselves, but for now it looks very likely we’ll be able to provide all outstanding physical add-on rewards at no further cost to backers. 

Here is a full list of the rewards we will be delivering to backers: 
[list] [*]Art book (digital and physical) 
 [*]Regular DVD copies of Woolfe 
 [*]Deluxe Boxed versions of Woolfe (including CD soundtrack) 
 [*]Poster packs 
 [*]Limited edition stickers 
 [*]Official documents of enlistment 
 [*]Original soundtrack (mp3) 
 [*]Ringtone (mp3) 
 [*]Wallpapers (HD JPG/PNG) 
 [*]Custom answering message (mp3)
 [/list]
Our aim is to deliver all these rewards to backers by the end of the year. Some items might take longer than others, and some may have to be changed from their original specification depending on the assets inherited from GRIN, but we’ll keep as close to original designs as practically possible. 

[h1]Are you going to continue to update the original Woolfe game?[/h1]
Not in the short term. Woolfe is built in Unreal Engine 3, which is completely separate to and incompatible with Rebellion’s own in-house game engine, Asura. For now it’s too early to say if we’ll be able to support the original Woolfe game in the future. That includes development of the previously mooted console versions, but we’ll be sure to look at and consider all possibilities as we evaluate what to do next. 

[h1]Will you ever make Woolfe Volume 2?[/h1]
To be honest, we’ve only just got our feet under the table, so it’s too early to say yet! Part of our purchase does include assets from a second volume of Woolfe that was in development, but the new game was far from being finished. 

At this stage, we’ve not had time to dig into all the game’s assets and code to properly assess what we have. Taking a game originally designed for Unreal Engine 3 and making it work in Rebellion’s own Asura engine is a huge task, and one we can’t take lightly! 

We’ll update you when we know more. 

[h1]What will happen to Woolfe’s Steam page?[/h1]
Rebellion has taken immediate ownership of Woolfe’s [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/281940/]Steam page[/url]. We’ll update it with some of the points discussed in this FAQ to make buyers and backers aware of the new situation, but aside from having a new name next to ‘Developer’ and ‘Publisher’, nothing major will change. 

The price will remain the same, and we’ll put the game on sale from time to time for Steam’s seasonal and weekly promotions. 

[h1]What will happen to the community forums?[/h1] 
We’ll have access to the game’s [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/281940]Steam Community Hub[/url] and will try to check in, moderate and update you where we can but please be patient - we have multiple projects at Rebellion and they have their own communities we need to work with too!

[h1]Will the Kickstarter page stay open?[/h1] 
Yes, and we will continue to update it when we have relevant news. So make sure to check in when you can! 

[h1]Has our Kickstarter money gone to you?[/h1] 
No money has passed to Rebellion with the purchase, only Woolfe’s IP and all assets (including some of the backer rewards) related to the game. Of course these were all at least partially funded by your pledges, so that’s why we want to make sure as many backers as possible who are missing rewards still get them! 

[h1]How do we get in touch with Rebellion?[/h1] 
Rebellion has a small in-house customer support team, so feel free to get in touch via the below options. Please remember that we typically work in UK office hours (9am-5.30pm, Monday-Friday) and try to respond within 24 working hours. 

[b]The Steam Community Hub
The Rebellion website [url=http://www.rebellion.co.uk/support]contact form[/url]
On Twitter: @Rebellion 
By email: woolfe.support@rebellion.co.uk [/b]

notes.title: We hear you!
notes.content:
It’s just over a week since we launched Woolfe - The Red Hood Diaries on Steam. 

We have received a lot of constructive feedback on how we might improve the game, for which we thank you. 

[h1]Update incoming[/h1]
Today we hope to show you that our team of 6 have been (and still are) listening to your ideas. Instead of taking a little rest after release, we have been working hard to fix bugs, add polish and even integrate some new elements. 
Yes, we now have lip-sync in the cutscenes where Red actually talks, but also new kill and die animations and effects, fixes in subtitles, difficulty based checkpoints and more...

The complete change-log will be available in our discussion forums once the build is live!

We have noticed that some of you have troubles with Red grabbing pipes and ledges. This is identified as a performance issue. Please consult our post about checking and optimizing performance on your computer (http://steamcommunity.com/app/281940/discussions/1/617330406663384799/)

Again, we want to thank you for believing in us!

The Woolfe Pack

notes.title: We hear you!
notes.content:
It’s just over a week since we launched Woolfe - The Red Hood Diaries on Steam. 

We have received a lot of constructive feedback on how we might improve the game, for which we thank you. 

[h1]Update incoming[/h1]
Today we hope to show you that our team of 6 have been (and still are) listening to your ideas. Instead of taking a little rest after release, we have been working hard to fix bugs, add polish and even integrate some new elements. 
Yes, we now have lip-sync in the cutscenes where Red actually talks, but also new kill and die animations and effects, fixes in subtitles, difficulty based checkpoints and more...

The complete change-log will be available in our discussion forums once the build is live!

We have noticed that some of you have troubles with Red grabbing pipes and ledges. This is identified as a performance issue. Please consult our post about checking and optimizing performance on your computer (http://steamcommunity.com/app/281940/discussions/1/617330406663384799/)

Again, we want to thank you for believing in us!

The Woolfe Pack

notes.title: Trailer, Bugs & Polish
notes.content:
[h1]Hi early birds![/h1]

Nobody likes people repeating themselves so I’ll keep it brief. With our deadline only a few days away, everyone’s working around the clock to get everything ready for release. That means a lot of polishing and fixing prior bugs, but also working on an updated release trailer...

[img]http://woolfegame.com/blog/wp-content/uploads/trailerwip.jpg[/img]

That also means it’s time for another changelog. Let’s go over some of the more important updates in today’s build. 

[list]
[*][b]Audio[/b]
Red now has some new taunts to tell the big rat in the sewers. New ambient sounds during the fight are added as well. 
Water sounds in the sewer level when the water rises or declines. 
Again, in the sewers, the double-ticking sound of the timer is fixed.
You’ll also notice there’s now a new bit of music accompanying the dancing guards in the market.
We did some normalization of the new voiceovers. 

[*][b]Animation[/b]
There’s a new little cinematic during the rat fight to accentuate the poison clouds.
Red’s footplacement while she’s sneaking should now be improved. Her footplacement on the boxes in the first level should look a whole lot better now as well.

[*][b]Collision fixes[/b]
Quite a lot of collision fixes for this update. Like in the Toy Workshop, in the tunnel towards the investigation files, the trees in the marketplace,...

[*][b]Changes in the levels[/b]
There’s now a fence in front of the stream pipes in the sewers.
Your calm and easy rides on the rafts in the harbour have now become a bit more difficult as we’ve added a couple of hurdles.
The hole in a ground at the sewer rat fight is now fixed as well as the issue of the framedrop during the poison phase.
The time reset for the sewer puzzle is working again properly.
The crate you push down in the market level now saves instantly.

[*][b]Other[/b]
We fixed the state resets when opening the pause menu. 
And there shouldn’t be any more kismet warnings.
There's a whole bunch of other stuff, most you might not even notice...
[/list]

Alright guys, that’s all for now!
We’ll be back very soon with more news and updates.

Cheers,
-The Woolfe Team

notes.title: ONE WEEK!!!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Countdown![/b][/h1]

Only 6 more days before the big release, how exciting! We are so close to our finish we can almost taste it… That also means we fix, we test and we polish everything over and over again. You’ve all been a tremendous help and support to us throughout the development and we hope you stick around for this final lap.

[h1][b]Twitchin’ from the kitchen[/b][/h1]

[img]http://woolfegame.com/blog/wp-content/uploads/twitch-update-gdc.jpg[/img]
CEO Wim is back in town and eager to talk about his press tour adventures in the USA, where he’s been promoting Woolfe both on GDC and PAX East. Curious to hear all about it? Then we invite you to come to tonight’s Twitch stream which will be held, for once, live from Wim’s kitchen.

Tonight/Tuesday at 7 GMT:
http://www.twitch.tv/WoolfeGame


[h1][b]Lend me your voice, Granny![/b][/h1]

‘Granny #4’, as we’ve been calling her, finished her recordings and, my goodness, she sounds AMAZING. We’re sure you’ll love her too and we can’t wait to show you -or, you know, let you hear her :-)
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gD8etg65xHw

[h1][b]Changelog[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Added/updated audio
We’ve added some new ambient sounds to a handful of things throughout the game. For example: the rafts in the harbor and the poison clouds during the big sewer rat fight. And we fixed the clock-ticking sounds in the sewers as well.

[*]Localization
There were a couple of subtitles missing in some of the added languages. This should have been fixed now. The Dutch and German Diary Unlocks are now completed as well, along with the Diary navigation.

[*]Bugfixes
No more odd collisions when trying to go for one of the secret in the harbour. 
Rats or collision should no longer kill you when the Piper pushes you off his platform.
Fixed Red’s foot placement on the crane and the wolf-traps in the tutorial level.
No more strange rooftop collision in the tutorial level.
The edges of the chariot in the market will no longer kill you. The platform reset in that same level should be fixed now as well.
Fixes some issues with the poison when you respawn at the rat fight.
Fixed the crash bug related to an AI issue.
You should not be getting a damage border when loading or respawning in a level.

[*]Pied Piper cinematic update
When you encounter the Pied Piper on the bridge in the harbour, the timing of the camera-shake was a bit off. Not any more!

[*]Forest chase
Red’s comments during the chase in the forest level should be working fine now.

[*]VSync
The VSync works now! This should fix some issues people have had in the past with screen-tearing. 

[*]Combo’s
When your 3 vials of magic are filled, you can now do 3 combo’s. Also, when performing a combo when the tooltip pops up now guarantees a successful action.

[*]Camera view
There were a couple of instances in which an object would block your camera view. Mainly in the beginning of the sewer level. We made a few tweaks here and there so you can now clearly see what you’re doing.

[*]Character spawning
All characters should now be spawning on the ground.

[*]Subtitle font change
While trying to add other languages, we noticed some characters not being displayed... The new font should have all characters included!
[/list]
Ok, dearest Birdies, that’s all!
Don’t forget the livestream later today!

Greets,
The Woolfe pack

notes.title: Sunday Update
notes.content:
[h1]Dearest early birds,[/h1]
So, how did our traditional Friday update become a Sunday update? Well, we worked our asses off to push out a build (and update) on Friday, but some things went pretty wrong there. Some of you may have seen and played the buggy build that should have never gone live: especially to those, we apologize. That was not the quality we meant to deliver to you. We took down the buggy build within a few hours and put the older version back online so we could continue fixing, which we did all weekend long. With a little delay, you can now find a decent updated Woolfe on Steam.
Now, let us take you through the other stuff that went on over the past few days.


[h1]Twitch Stream Reminder[/h1]
GRIN’s Wim Wouters has spent this week in the US, talking to press at GDC and PAX. By Tuesday, he will be back in Belgium and happily give you all a report on how things have been. Meet our big boss Tuesady at 8 PM GMT on our Twitch channel: http://www.twitch.tv/WoolfeGame


[h1]Granny update[/h1]
Follwing the public casting, we contacted your and our favorite voice actresses for the part of Granny. Number 3 and 4 were everyone’s favorites and we are super excited to confirm now that Granny #4 is on board and recording her scenes as we speak! (http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gD8etg65xHw). She’s gonna kick ass as Red’s grandma!


[h1]Changelog[/h1]
So what’s in today’s build, you wonder? 

[b]Adjustable difficulties[/b]
You will now be able to play the game on three different difficulty settings: Easy, Medium and Hard. Think you’re up for that?

[b]Toy Soldier editor integration[/b]
The Kickstarter backers will be pleased to know that the Toy Soldier editor is now integrated in-game! While you’re playing the game, there’s a chance you’ll encounter one of these customized soldiers. Once it’s defeated, you will see a notification on screen. These will give you extra skill-points you can afterwards use to add more upgrades to your own Toy Soldier. 
(The Toy Soldier Editor is a feature for Kickstarter backers only but none-kickstarter backers can still encounter these creations in-game. You are able to remove this option in the settings menu.)

[b]Sewer boss-fight cutscene[/b]
We realized there were some people who had difficulty understanding what they were supposed to do when they encountered the giant sewer rat. To fix that problem we integrated a new cutscene at the beginning of the fight.

[b]Shadow tweaking[/b]
We’ve made some adjustments concerning Red’s own shadow and we think it actually looks a lot more realistic and believable now. 

[b]Boss fight icons[/b]
During a boss fight, you can now see that their health bars on the right hand side are accompanied by a little icon with their face on it. 

[b]Bugfixes[/b]
No update would be complete without some bugfixes. These include:
[list]
[*]Checkpoints: There were some issues with some checkpoints in the past. No need to worry about missing a checkpoint now.
[*]Tutorial: In the Tutorial level, all jumps should now be doable in a single jump.
[*]Forest chase: The traps in the forest chase level now do damage. As they should.
[*]Collision fixes: There have been a lot of collision fixes, mainly in the Pied Piper hideout and the market chase. 
[/list]

[b]Dutch subtitles[/b]
Along with English, French and German, we’ve now added Dutch subtitles to the game. They should all be working now. Dutch unlockable content and menu stuff still needs to be implemented and adjusted. 
A big, warm ‘thank you’ to everyone who helped us with the localization! You’re truly amazing people and we’re very glad we have some devoted fans who were willing to lend us a hand!
We’d also like to ask our French, German, Dutch (and English) speaking community to keep an eye out for any flaws or mistakes in the subtitles and report them to us so we can correct them.


[h1]Meanwhile at the office…[/h1]
We’re also working on lots of stuff you can not see (just yet). The localisation process is in full progress (Japanese, Russian and Spanish), we’re doing some Red re-recordings, having some new music delivered, we’re finishing off the final boss fight and scenes and are working hard on a new Woofle website for the launch of the game. Artist Bram had a lot of fun with the designs so far. Especially highlighting our game’s features :-)

[img]http://woolfegame.com/img/woolfewebsite_sneakpeek.png[/img]

That’s all folks!
See you Tuesday on Twitch?

-The Woolfe Pack

notes.title: Fairytale Friday (Part 2)
notes.content:
[h1]Rise and shine, early birds![/h1]
[img]http://woolfegame.com/blog/wp-content/uploads/WoolfeGranny.jpg[/img]
Since we were unable to provide a new build last Tuesday, we’ll have a big one today! It’s only 18 more days before the big release and it’s ‘all hands on deck’ right now. Let’s have a look at what we’ve been up to, shall we?

[h1]Twitch: Live from GDC[/h1]
Next Tuesday, March 3rd,  it’s time for our special edition Twitch Livestream. Wim will be meeting with press in the USA all through next week and he’ll Twitch live from GDC in San Francisco. Definitely worth checking out! Exact timing to be confirmed. 

[h1]Granny, what nice voice you have![/h1]
It was great to see so many of you have casted your votes on the Granny Voice Audition. Number 4 was everyone’s favorite by a long shot… including the devs’! It’s awesome to see we all mutually agree on this so far. We’re still receiving a lot of auditions and will close the submissions on Tuesday. Who knows, there might still be an even better Granny out there. Until then, #4 will remain our current favorite. We’ll keep you posted!
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gD8etg65xHw

[h1]Localization[/h1]
Another update on the localization/subtitle front: Woolfe writer Yasmin is currently finalizing the Dutch subtitles (and she’s super happy to be writing in her mother tongue again for a change!).  We hope to implement the Dutch version before the next update. 

[h1]Changelog[/h1]
Alright, time for this week’s changelog... Update should be online in a few hours!
[list]
[*][b]Boss fight[/b]

Alright birdies, that’s it for this week’s update!
We’ll see you soon!

-The Woolfe team

notes.title: Twitch recap & Friday update
notes.content:
[img]http://woolfegame.com/blog/wp-content/uploads/4cards.png[/img]

[h1]Hello birdies![/h1]
 
We were very pleased to see last Tuesday’s Twitch stream had even more watchers than the one before. And, of course, of all the nice reviews we received and the constructive comments you all gave us.
 
We took you through the Forest Adrift level to check which areas need some improvements. We discovered the difficult areas along with a bug here and there that we’ll be fixing soon. (I’m looking at you, glitching fairies.)
 
[b]Next Twitch: you pick![/b]
Ok, so for our next Twitch session (on Tuesday, February 17th) we have two possible topics on the menu:
[list]
[*]A Q&A with lead programmer Jelle on “the combat”
[*]A Q&A with writer Yasmin on “the story”
[/list]
Let us know which talk you would prefer in the comments section below this post. The most favored one is the one we’ll serve next tuesday!
 
 
[h1]Change log[/h1]
 
It’s Friday so you know what that means: A new build! This build will be available later today in your Steam library so keep an eye out for this new update. We’ve fixed some bugs, added a couple new, cool features and still continue on polishing the game before the big release!
 
So… What has changed this week?
[list]
[*][b]Story Mode:[/b] In addition to the previous build (in which Red could now no longer run, jump and fight in the narrative areas of the game) we also changed her animation during these scenes.
 
[*][b]Sewer Bossfight:[/b] The small rats in the sewers are now not the only ones attacking Red any more. Better watch out for the giant rat you’ll now have to fight as well!
 
[*][b]Combat Balancing:[/b] Along with the new key bindings integrated last week, we’ve continued to work on better balancing the combat. Mainly: the marketplace and the harbour. Your feedback is very much appreciated and we’d love to hear what you think about this new feature.
 
[*][b]Mini-Market Removed:[/b] To prevent any further frustrations, we’ve removed the mini-market from the game and replaced it with the original ‘dancing guards’ again. We felt that it’d be better if we develop on the mini-market a bit better before putting it back in the game.
 
[*][b]Wooden Bridge fixed:[/b] In the Forest Adrift level, you might have noticed there is a collapsible wooden bridge. The problem was that, when you died and respawned, the bridge was still broken. We managed to fix this bug and the wooden bridge should now reset properly.
[/list]
[img]http://woolfegame.com/blog/wp-content/uploads/4cards.png[/img]

[h1]Achievements and trading cards[/h1]
 
A few days ago we asked you all for inspiration for (Steam) achievements and so far, we’ve received some really cool suggestions on our Facebook and Twitter channels. Keep them coming, guys! Meanwhile, the team is preparing all the artwork for the Steam badges and trading cards and will be ready to go soon.


That’s all folks!
See you next Tuesday.

Cheers,

The Woolfe Pack

[h1][b]Gooood morning, early birds![/b][/h1]

What a week and a half this has been!

Thanks to you; our wonderful community; we’ve received an astonishing amount of helpful feedback, detailed bug reports, creative suggestions and highly appreciated support. Taking everyone’s reviews into account, we’re working hard on polishing the game. One step closer to the big release! (Exciting!)

Thank you all for helping us out so far. Keep up the amazing work, guys!

[h1][b]Twitch Brainstorm Follow-up[/b][/h1]

Last Tuesday, we held our first community brainstorm on Twitch. The first of many, for sure! Luckily, everything ran smoothly. Nobody held back on ideas and suggestions concerning a boss fight in the sewers. 

Missed the stream? Don’t worry! You can re-watch it right here: http://www.twitch.tv/woolfegame/b/620035048

Out of all the things we’ve discussed, there were a couple of things we found very interesting and which we’re trying to put into action. 
[list]
[*][b]A giant rat as ‘mini’-boss.[/b]
Including some hordes of smaller rats. (The big mother and her babies)
When defeated, she breaks the gate through which you can continue your pursuit of the Piper.
[*][b]Poisonous gas.[/b]
The green gas coming from the two vents on either side of the open sewer pipe is currently not poisonous but making it poisonous could provide an extra level of difficulty for Red whilst fighting the rat hordes. 
[*][b]Etc...[/b]
[/list]
[h1][b]Next Tuesday’s Twitch[/b][/h1]

Thanks to success of last Tuesday’s stream, we’ve decided to make this a weekly thing. So next tuesday we’ll be back on Twitch with some more live updates -including our progress on the sewer level boss rat-  and another brainstorm session.
This time the theme will be: [b]‘Combat upgrades’[/b]. Have a little think and if you’d like to share your ideas on how to improve the in-game combat, we’d be more than happy to hear them from you during our next Twitch stream. (Or, as always, in our community forums!)

[h1][b]FRIDAY BUILD V 2.0.5 - Change log:[/b][/h1]
It’s Friday again, that means another build! With every build we’re fixing as much bugs as possible, but we’re also trying to add some and fix some other stuff… Build will be available later today, so keep an eye on your Steam library for updates!
[list]
[*][b]Story mode:[/b] Red can no longer run, jump and fight in the narrative area’s of the game.
[*][b]Chase level:[/b] You know the level where you have to run away from the camera and the electro guards were chasing you? Or actually not really chasing you... ;) Should be fixed now!
[*][b]First subtitles:[/b] We’ve included a test for the subtitles in the new build. They are currently translated by Microsoft Online Translator System. You can imagine this gives a few very strange results.
[/list]

[h1][b]WE NEED YOU (...for translations this time)[/b][/h1]

The English subtitles are now completed and should be fully implemented in-game! Whoo-hoo! But... that’s only the beginning. Our goal is to translate these subtitles in many different languages. And for that, we need your help. 
Basically, we’re looking for volunteers who are willing and able to help us out with this.

The link below will take you to ‘Transifex’. There you can find all snippets of texts, categorized per language. The more help we get, the sooner these will all be filled and the sooner we can start the implementation. 

Interested? Click right here:  https://www.transifex.com/projects/p/woolfe
[i]
*Before we release all translations will be checked and corrected by a professional native editor for each language to ensure highest possible quality standards.
*Some texts have been auto-translated. You will find some funny and crazy translations here and there. Feel free to correct them ;)
[/i]

[h1]That’s it for this week![/h1]
We’ll be back with another update on Tuesday.

Enjoy your weekend!

Cheers,

The Woolfe Pack

notes.title: Come on, let’s Twitch tonight
notes.content:
[h1]Good day, dear early access birds![/h1]

We are now exactly one week into our Early Access trajectory, and boy - we are thrilled to have received such valuable feedback, bug reports, reviews, questions and ideas from all of you. Your input has been priceless and highly motivational to us; proud to have you on our team! Thank you!

[h1]Twitch and shout: Today/Tuesday at 10 PM CET (1 PM PST)[/h1]
[url=http://www.twitch.tv/WoolfeGame]http://www.twitch.tv/WoolfeGame[/url]


Last Friday, we called out for your help to co-create a piece of level with us. A (micro) boss fight in the sewer, to be precise. What do you think would be cool gameplay mechanics and ingredients to use for a boss fight featuring Red and the Pied Piper at this underground location? Join us on Twitch later today to share your ideas!

Wim Wouters (the big boss), Steven Melis (the level designer), Jelle Voet and Yana Roggeman (the programmers) will welcome you with open arms and minds at 10 PM (CET), on our Twitch channel.


[b]Woolfe in progress[/b]
So, here’s a little update on what we've been up to since our change log last Friday. Update will be online in about an hour or so...

[b]Changelog V2.0.4:[/b]
[list]
[*]Red’s foot placement issues have been fixed
[*]Menu sounds have been added: like or don’t like? Suggestions welcome!
[*]In the city level, the dancing toy soldiers have danced off to make room for a whole new sneaky level design: check out our brand new “mini market”! ([url=http://woolfegame.com/blog/wp-content/uploads/screenshot-City_SneakTut01.jpg]mini market[/url])

[/list]

For now, that’s all, folks!
Hope to see you and your brilliant ideas on Twitch tonight.

Cheers,

The Woolfe Pack

notes.title: NEW UPDATE & HOMEWORK
notes.content:
Hi there, you early access birds!

Okay… day 4 on Early Access, and what a rollercoaster it has been. We want to thank each and everyone of you for buying, liking, sharing our [b]Woolfe - The Red Hood Diaries[/b]. For reviewing it, for giving us feedback - you’ve been a tremendous help, really.
We’re on a mission to answer and process your questions and remarks as fast as we can (finger cramp!).

[h1][b]NEW BUILD UPDATE LIVE: V2.0.3[/b][/h1]

[h1]Change log:[/h1]
You probably noticed we pushed out a few quick-fix updates already, but we’ve also been doing some larger upgrades and fixes. Here is an overview of the most noticeable things we’ve been working on the past few days.

Pied Piper Boss-fight:
[list]
[*]Fixed: errors in PP turn when RRH gets kicked off the platform
[*]Fixed: RRH input control during PP start cinematic
[/list]
Environment bugs:
[list]
[*]Collision fixes in tutorial rooftops
[*]Collision fixes in sewers
[*]Harbour secret decor cleaned
[*]Tutorial ledge tooltip fixed
[*]Fixed secrets in crates
[*]Market carriage rope fixed
[*]Market carriage jump-cheat fixed
[*]Market doors lock fixed
[*]Floating rock near secret fixed
[*]Woods chase reset fixed
[*]Woods secret fixed
[*]Woods holes in decor fixed
[/list]
GUI / Menu:
[list]
[*]Tooltip upgrade
[*]Skip cinematic indicator
[*]Keyboard input customization fix
[*]Bug reporter fix
[*]Music added
[/list]
Programming:
[list]
[*]No more level clipping when dying
[*]Less camera clipping (ex: sewers ceiling)
[*]Damage volume interval fixed (Pied Piper boss-fight)
[*]Removed combo level-up visual from early levels
[*]Default difficulty marked as 'coming soon'
[*]Default language marked as 'coming soon'
[*]Subtitles marked as 'coming soon'
[*]Checkpoints fixed
[*]Missing guards fixed
[*]Remaining damage volumes in Pied Piper battle fixed
[/list]

PS: A lot of people have been asking us about the subtitles… No worries, we’re on it! Integration of the English subtitles starts next week on Monday.

[h1][b]S.O.S. Boss Fight: join us on Twitch![/b][/h1]
For those who are interested: we’ll be doing a live brainstorm on Twitch next tuesday about a very specific area in the Sewer Side level: 

[url=http://woolfegame.com/blog/wp-content/uploads/PP_Combat_Arena1.jpg]CHECK IMAGE HERE[/url]

Looks familiar? Well, what’s to come here is a first encounter with the Pied Piper. Yes, a boss fight. 
Call for help: What do you think would be cool gameplay mechanics and ingredients to use for a boss fight featuring the Pied Piper at this underground location? If you have some spare time over the weekend, have a look at the scene, write down some ideas and join us on Twitch next week to talk about it.

[b]The topic: Sewer Side, first boss fight with Pied Piper[/b]
[b]When: Tuesday February 3rd, 1 PM PST (10 PM CET)[/b]
Where to go? [url=http://www.twitch.tv/woolfegame]http://www.twitch.tv/woolfegame[/url]
Who to expect? Wim Wouters (the big boss), Steven Melis (the level designer) and Jelle Voet and Yana Roggeman (the programmers) 

All other bugs, issues, questions remain very welcome on the discussions forum. We’ll be monitoring them closely. 
We will try to post an update here -with progress, questions and calls for help- every tuesday and friday from now on, so stay tuned.

Enjoy your weekend!

Cheers,

The Woolfe Pack
